name: Unicoi County Apple Festival

timing.recurrence_description: Annually on the first full weekend in October

rules.booth_rules: Main Street requires handmade crafts and bans resale items. Vendors must provide their own tables and tents.

sources_consulted.purpose: Third party verification of dates and details

search_queries_used: "Unicoi County Apple Festival" vendor application booth fee 2026
extraction_notes: Identified 'The apple art fest in TN' as the Unicoi County Apple Festival in Erwin, TN, a major annual open-air event with 420+ vendors. Used Google search to confirm event details and locate vendor application information. Booth fees are $300 for side street and $350 for main street (handmade only). Electricity is available for $40. Vendors must provide their own tables and tents. The event is held annually on the first full weekend in October (October 2-3 in 2026). A human should verify if 3D-printing is considered 'handmade' by the organizers, as Main Street requires handmade crafts and bans resale items.
